evidenceAccessDefinitions.primary_page: Relevant rendered page/PDF passage inspected; not a complete review of every page, trim or market.
evidenceAccessDefinitions.primary_indexed_excerpt: Official manufacturer/importer indexed passage inspected; complete original document retrieval is not claimed.
evidenceAccessDefinitions.primary_indexed_excerpt_with_current_red: Older primary indexed passage retained with an explicit current-redirect limitation; a second exact-model manual provides additional evidence.
evidenceAccessDefinitions.prior_phase_record: Retained revision-1 primary observation with its existing scope/limits; original access is not re-certified in this revision.
